name: Zapier
freeTierNote: $0 plan with 100 tasks/mo and two-step Zaps.
bestFor: Non-developers connecting popular SaaS tools this afternoon
skipIf: Your volume will make task pricing embarrassing, or you need on-prem
keyFeatures: Largest consumer & B2B SaaS app catalog
Built-in tables, interfaces, and agent layers
limitations: Per-task billing escalates quickly at high volume
No self-hosted or on-prem deployment option
summary: The default no-code glue. Enormous app catalog. Task meters are the business.
body: Zapier still wins when the app you need is obscure and you are not going to write a webhook. AI agents (Central and friends) sit on top of the catalog. The free plan caps out at 100 tasks/month on two-step Zaps, while Professional starts at $29.99/mo monthly ($19.99/mo annual). For high volume, self-hosted n8n or a custom worker is cheaper.
notes: Count tasks before you celebrate a multi-step Zap
Make.com is the usual price/flexibility fork
